assumptions.text: All times are same-day local clock labels; no date or timezone is supplied. Unspecified cameras and the badge log are provisionally treated as sharing a clock, without an independent synchronisation audit.
Confirmed record means the supplied exhibit contains the observation; it does not authenticate a human identity, prove a statement true, or certify record completeness.
The assignment’s coat-to-name mapping is a contextual association only. Badge entries identify credentials rather than their human users.

missing_intervals_and_movements.text: No image shows the removal itself. The directly established absence window is after the 18:00 presence and by the 18:18 absence.
The east-corridor visit is only a snapshot; movement between that location and the lab is not continuously observed.
The service link to the lab is unmonitored, so unrecorded or unauthenticated movement remains possible.
The cafeteria and reception snapshots do not cover the full incident window; there is no supplied travel-time model or continuous alibi.
